queries.name: distribucion_referencias_recetas
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
    SystemType,
    TipoComponente,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN InsumoID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS con_insumo_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SubRecetaProductoID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS con_subreceta_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ProductoCodigoFuente IS NOT NULL
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ProductoCodigoFuente)) <> ''
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_codigo_producto
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, TipoComponente
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType, TipoComponente

queries.name: vinculacion_producto_codigo
queries.sql:
WITH productos AS (
    SELECT
        ServerID,
        SystemType,
        CodigoFuente,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS coincidencias
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos
    GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    r.SystemType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.coincidencias IS NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_producto_codigo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.coincidencias = 1
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_unica,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.coincidencias > 1
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_ambigua
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN productos p
    ON p.ServerID = r.ServerID
   AND p.SystemType = r.SystemType
   AND p.CodigoFuente = r.ProductoCodigoFuente
GROUP BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType
ORDER BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType

queries.name: vinculacion_subrecetas
queries.sql:
WITH productos AS (
    SELECT
        ServerID,
        ProductoID,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS coincidencias
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos
    GROUP BY ServerID, ProductoID
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS subrecetas_referenciadas,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.coincidencias IS NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_producto_subreceta,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.coincidencias = 1
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_unica,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.coincidencias > 1
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_ambigua
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN productos p
    ON p.ServerID = r.ServerID
   AND p.ProductoID = r.SubRecetaProductoID
WHERE r.SubRecetaProductoID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.ServerID
ORDER BY r.ServerID

queries.name: integridad_insumos_referenciados
queries.sql:
WITH insumos AS (
    SELECT
        ServerID,
        InsumoID,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS coincidencias
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
    GROUP BY ServerID, InsumoID
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes_con_insumo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.coincidencias IS NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_insumo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.coincidencias = 1
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_unica,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.coincidencias > 1
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_ambigua
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN insumos i
    ON i.ServerID = r.ServerID
   AND i.InsumoID = r.InsumoID
WHERE r.InsumoID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.ServerID
ORDER BY r.ServerID

queries.name: empresas_sucursales_servidor
queries.sql:
SELECT
    e.EmpresaID,
    e.CodigoEmpresa,
    CONVERT(varchar(36), es.ServidorID) AS ServerID,
    es.CodigoSucursalSistema,
    es.NumeroSucursalSistema,
    es.RolConexion,
    es.Activo,
    es.EsPrincipal
FROM dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores es
JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas e
    ON e.EmpresaID = es.EmpresaID
ORDER BY
    e.EmpresaID,
    es.CodigoSucursalSistema,
    es.NumeroSucursalSistema

objective: Diagnosticar exclusivamente en lectura las claves de vinculacion entre productos, recetas, insumos y subrecetas sincronizadas. No modificar datos.
